title: Trainee Structural Drafter
location: Newcastle NSW (board location tag: Sydney CBD/Parramatta)
content_text:
Trainee Structural Drafter
Sydney CBD/Parramatta
Permanent / Full Time
Cadet/Trainee
Civil/Structural - Drafting
10/9/2026
Launch your new career as a Drafter with Northrop!
Company culture that is respectful, inclusive and supportive
Flexible Working | Industry Benchmarked Salary Package | Annual Salary Reviews
Looking to learn from some of the best drafters in Newcastle to launch your new career? Join Northrop’s local Newcastle team and build a long-term career working alongside a team of experienced and passionate civil and structural drafters
What is Drafting and what does a Draftsperson do?
A Draftsperson produces Engineering documents. Our drawings are used to tell a story about a building, site preparation, installation procedures, materials to use and products to install, all with the aim of allowing a builder to do his job and a client's visions to come to life.
If you have an interest in Drawing, Computers, 3D Documentation, Animation, Design, Engineering, Construction, Building, and telling a story through drawings then this type of work might be for you!
The Role
Our Newcastle office has multiple exciting opportunities for Trainee Structural Drafters to join our team. Working with professional and experienced teams on local, exciting and prestigious projects, you will be provided with extensive on-the-job training and mentoring. You will develop skills in the latest discipline specific Engineering technologies and gain vast experience as part of our Trainee Draftsperson Program.
Current positions are available in:
Structural Drafting (producing Engineering documentation and 3D models)
Bridge Drafting (producing road and pedestrian documentation and 3D models)
Shop Detailing (producing fabrication ready documentation and 3D models)
Our trainee drafters will get the opportunity to be involved in any or all of the three listed above, gaining valuable skills and rewarding career opportunities.
Successful applicants will get to continue their learning by completing engineering studies at TAFE, usually 1 day a week, as part of an industry recognised traineeship. The other 4 days will be based in the office. Along with an industry-competitive salary, all TAFE fees will be covered for your studies.
Why Northrop?
We’re employee owned. That means the people working in our business have a genuine stake in its future.
There are no external shareholders or overseas parent company. Decisions are made by people who understand our work, our clients and our people. Our leaders are accessible, and when you have an idea for doing something better, you’ll be encouraged to share it.
For more than 50 years, we’ve built our business around our people, our relationships and the impact our work has on communities.
Today, our multidisciplinary teams work across NSW, ACT, Queensland and Victoria on projects of all sizes, spanning sectors including health, education, residential, commercial, industrial, sport and land development.
The Candidate
If you have recently completed or are currently completing your School Certificate or HSC, or you have started your Drafting course at TAFE and have an interest in pursuing a career in drafting, your future could be at Northrop! You will have access to many opportunities within Northrop and with our support, we will help you to develop your career.
As the successful candidate you will possess:
A passion for STEM subjects, particularly Technology and Engineering.
Computer literacy with a keen interest in technical drawing. Exposure to packages such as AutoCAD, Revit or Tekla while not required, is highly desirable.
The ability to work independently or collaboratively as part of a team.
Enthusiasm along with a passion for the construction and engineering industry.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
What’s In It For You
Industry-benchmarked salary with annual reviews, we pay properly and revisit it every year.
Genuine flexibility: hybrid working, flexible hours, alternative public holidays, we’ll have a real conversation about what works for you
Paid parental leave for primary carers, maternity, and partners
Salary income protection insurance
Monthly one-on-one career development conversations, mentoring programs, and investment in both internal and external training
Free EAP and wellbeing support.
A positive and enjoyable workplace with a supportive team, a relaxed culture, and regular opportunities to connect through social activities and company events throughout the year.
A diverse range of projects and opportunities, from small residential developments to major hospitals, race tracks, airports, and everything in between. With such a broad variety of work, there's always something new to keep your role interesting and rewarding.
Ready?
To apply for this role, please submit a comprehensive resume as well as a brief covering letter by clicking on the “Apply” tab.
If this role is not quite what you are after but are interested in finding out more about future opportunities with Northrop, please head over to our EOI link:
https://v2.forms.jobadder.com/f/WzDLJEnGePglWrqXoxNZ7A32Y
Northrop is an equal opportunity employer. We actively welcome applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, people of all genders, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, and people from culturally and linguistically diverse backgrounds. If you need any adjustments to participate in our recruitment process, let us know — we’ll make it work.
